evidence.source_sentence: Contact Angle Measurements. Contact angles were measured on aJY-82 goniometer. The polymer solutions in THF $( 5 \mathrm { m g / m L } )$ were cast onto glass slides to form polymer films, after which the samples were stayed at room temperature under vacuum for 24 h. The sessile drop method was performed. Deionized water drops $( \leq 0 . 5 \mu \mathrm { L } )$ were positioned onto the polymer surfaces by means of the syringe. All the contact angle data were read from the scale on the microscope lens at the 15th second after the water dropping.
